job: Enter a colour with a picker or a hex code and see how it reads on the page.
purpose: A native colour input beside a hex box. The box carries the name and posts #rrggbb as a plain field; the picker is inert until script runs. With script the two stay in step, short hex codes are completed, and a list shows the colour's contrast on the page and against the accent, measured live and worded as well as marked with an icon.
useWhen: A brand or accent colour is entered by a person, as in branding or theme settings.
The chosen colour will sit on the page, so its legibility matters.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing from a few preset colours.
Showing a colour that cannot be edited.

states.name: invalid
states.how: aria-invalid="true" on the hex box, with a .fd-field-error

states.name: disabled
states.how: disabled on the hex box and the picker

parts.role: The native colour input, with no name.
One row: icon, name, ratio, verdict.

keyboard.does: Moves between the picker and the hex box.
On the picker, opens the browser's colour dialog.
